DISCOVER THE COMBINATION ↓

TWO DESTINATIONS. ONE REMARKABLE TRIP.

One journey.
Two extraordinary
fisheries.

Six spots have become available on Rio Marié for November 7–14, 2027, opening the possibility of pairing a week in its remote blackwaters with an extension to Pirarucú. Planned connections bring two distinctive fly-fishing experiences together in one coordinated journey.

01

Rio Marié

Spend six full days of guided fishing in pursuit of trophy peacock bass in the remote blackwaters of the Amazon. Between sessions on the water, stay aboard the Untamed Amazon vessel, combining the adventure of a remote fishery with the comfort of life on board.

02

Pirarucú

Continue to Pirarucú Lodge in the Mamirauá Reserve, where flooded forests set the scene for a different challenge: giant arapaima. Target tambaqui and arowana as well, adding new species, habitats, and fishing experiences to your Amazon journey.

03

A connected journey

A charter connection to Tefé and onward transfer are planned to bring you to Pirarucú Lodge on the same day you leave Rio Marié, without an overnight stop in Manaus. Final connections depend on flight availability and your confirmed itinerary.
